# dTdt_tot

`#!python Thermodynamics.dTdt_tot`

*property*

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Total temperature rate `(Ė_tot − Σ_i ∂E/∂n_i · ṅ_i) / (∂E/∂T)` [K s⁻¹].

Equal to `dTdt_chemical + dTdt_extra`, built as a single fraction.
